title: SidechainAnalyzer and MaskingCarver — masking metric, bounded carve, suggestion mode
description:
Implement external-sidechain masking analysis and bounded carve processing per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §10. v1.0 uses host external sidechain only (no private IPC).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §10.1–10.5 (purpose, Overlap/Dominance/Masking metrics, G_carve, modes, collision map, product boundary)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §18 (audio-thread rules; fixed memory; disable heavy work when off)
- Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.* multi-consumer / power accumulation patterns if present (read only; may build ERB/octave bands independently with fixed filters or simple band power accumulators)
- Source/DSP/DynamicProcessor.* / ParametricBand.* bell dynamics patterns for carve filter style (read only)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h sidechain / lockIn / carve params if present (read only)
- CMakeLists.txt (read only; h.5 owns registration)

Implement Source/DSP/SidechainAnalyzer.h and Source/DSP/SidechainAnalyzer.cpp:
1. Accumulate main and sidechain power into a fixed number of ERB- or octave-spaced bands (document band count; fixed at prepare).
2. Per band compute:
   Overlap(b,t) = min(P_M,P_S)/(max(P_M,P_S)+eps)
   Dominance(b,t) = P_S/(P_M+P_S+eps)
   Masking(b,t) = Overlap * Dominance * A_S(b,t)
   with sidechain activity gate A_S and epsilon floors; all finite.
3. prepare/reset/process or pushMain/pushSidechain block APIs: audio-thread safe copies or lightweight band filters; no heap in process; when disabled, near-zero work.
4. Collision map data for GUI: fixed-capacity recent time × frequency masking scores (fixed history depth at prepare); getters for latest Masking vector, optional dominant-source flag, G_carve request per band. No paint/UI code.
5. Graceful absence of sidechain: if sidechain channels unavailable / silent, Masking→0 and carve recommendations idle (standalone-safe).

Implement Source/DSP/MaskingCarver.h and Source/DSP/MaskingCarver.cpp:
1. Apply bounded carve gains using a small fixed number of dynamic bell filters (document max bands, e.g. 4–8).
   G_carve(b,t) = -min(G_max, K * max(0, Masking(b,t) - T)) with exposed G_max, K, T.
2. Modes (data/flags even if processor wiring later):
   - Suggestion mode: convert high-collision bands into editable suggestion descriptors (center Hz, Q, suggested depth) without altering audible audio until accepted.
   - Auto mode: apply carve ONLY on explicitly enabled carver bands (never silent auto-everything).
3. prepare/reset/process stereo (and optional mid-only/side-only placement hooks if cheap); smoothed gains; clamp depths; true bypass when module/all bands disabled.
4. APIs to import analyzer metrics, enable individual carver bands, read suggestion list (fixed capacity), and clear suggestions.
5. No PluginProcessor, MidSideRouter, LookaheadDelay, MonoGuard, tests, or CMakeLists changes.

C++20/JUCE style consistent with Source/. verification_commands left empty.
acceptance_criteria: SidechainAnalyzer computes Overlap, Dominance, and Masking with A_S gate over fixed ERB/octave bands per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §10.2
Collision-map / latest-masking getters expose fixed-capacity frequency×time (or latest vector + history) data without GUI code
MaskingCarver applies G_carve = -min(G_max, K*max(0, Masking-T)) via a small fixed set of dynamic bells with true bypass when disabled
Suggestion mode yields editable descriptors without audible change; Auto mode applies only explicitly enabled carver bands
Missing/silent sidechain yields zero masking / idle carve (standalone-safe); no heap in process paths
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: auto-apply all suggestions to audible path without explicit band enable/accept

allowed: fixed ERB or octave filterbank with preallocated band powers
small fixed dynamic-bell bank for carves reusing project biquad/TPT style
suggestion structs in fixed array with accept/enable gating
idle path when sidechain energy below activity gate
